purpose: Require an active worker to keep performing useful work while the program remains non-terminal until the bounded turn closes with a verified same-canonical continuation or authority is otherwise safely transferred.

pre_final_authorization.authorization_rule: Honor operator pause and terminal states first. Otherwise apply turn_decision and all bounded close requirements; verified continuation alone is never sufficient.

turn_decision.clock: Observed authorized work start through close; elapsed is NOT useful-work duration. Capture wake time separately; startup must not reset the platform safety budget.
order: Honor operator pause/STOP before work and scheduler mutation.
After each unit choose primary, independent fallback, then smallest authorized runnable unit.
Continue if a candidate plus measured close reserve fits the remaining turn budget.
Close normally only at the target boundary, or after 480 seconds when no smaller safe unit fits plus close reserve; record candidates and estimates.
Before 480 seconds close only for an allowlisted concrete short_turn_reason with alternatives_checked.
Checkpoint, verify continuation unless paused/terminal, validate the new run record, then report.
turn_decision.close_reserve_rule: Estimate from observed recent close cost; never use an arbitrary large reserve to justify early exit. Never pad or extend work to meet a useful-seconds quota.
turn_decision.pause_rule: state/NOW.json execution_status=PAUSED forbids new work and self-rearm; checkpoint only and report PAUSED.
